proposedContracts.name: matches native WVE copy framecrc, decode to WAV AU and s16le, and A-law remux for seven data lengths and four header durations
proposedContracts.scope: Synthesized WVE files, 7 data lengths x 4 header durations; copy framecrc, decoded framecrc, s16le, WAV, AU and A-law remux byte-exact against native.

proposedContracts.name: matches native WVE output -ss -t and -frames:a, input -ss with an exact header duration, and forced -f wve over an altered magic
proposedContracts.scope: 512-sample packet timing under output -ss/-t/-frames:a, input -ss with an equal header duration only, and forced -f wve over an altered magic.

proposedContracts.name: fails detection like native for an altered magic byte or a nonzero byte 23 and refuses the unmirrored seek and truncated header
proposedContracts.scope: Twelve probe negatives fail in both (native 183, Edge 1 with no output); mismatched-duration input seek and truncated headers refused before output.

notes: Needed shared edit (not made): detect.ts throws a plain Error for 'Unsupported audio container signature' (exit 1); native exits 183. Mapping it to containerRefusal(...,183) or an execution error with exitCode 183 would close the gap for every format.

Native output with a header duration of equal, 100, 0 or larger than the data was identical in every tested case, including input -ss probes in exploration; input -ss with a mismatched duration is still refused, as the spec requires, because native's seek and EOF behaviour has not been mirrored systematically.
open() does not check the magic, mirroring wve_read_header under -f wve; detection checks it through the probe.
Setup durations: submodule init 39s, npm ci 8s, reference:build 173s.
